sentences.text: Garden State is a 2004 American romantic comedy-drama film , written and directed by Zach Braff and starring Braff , Natalie Portman , Peter Sarsgaard , and Ian Holm .	Zach Braff	Zach Braff	Natalie Portman	Natalie Portman	Peter Sarsgaard	Peter Sarsgaard	Ian Holm	Ian Holm	romantic	Romance film	comedy-drama film	Comedy-drama
The film centers on Andrew Largeman -LRB- Braff -RRB- , a 26-year-old actor/waiter who returns to his hometown in New Jersey after his mother dies .	New Jersey	New Jersey
Braff based the film on his real life experiences .
It was filmed in April and May 2003 and released on July 28 , 2004 .
New Jersey was the main setting and primary shooting location .	New Jersey	New Jersey
Garden State received positive reviews upon its release and has garnered a cult following .	cult following	cult following
It was an official selection of the Sundance Film Festival .	Sundance	Sundance Film Festival	Sundance Film Festival	Sundance Film Festival
